summary.e2eNote: Task #863 update: confirmed E2E spec coverage already exists for all 5 target apps (aegis, vessels, terra, carlota-jo, command) with smoke/route/mobile-viewport blocks and availability guards. Identified and fixed two related defects: (a) bare `goto(VESSELS_PATH)` calls hit `/vessels` (no trailing slash) and Vite returned a 103-byte 'did you mean /vessels/?' error page; (b) the route smoke tables used `{ path: '', label: 'home' }` which produced the same bare URL when concatenated. Fix: kept BASE_PATH without trailing slash (so `${BASE}${route.path}` gives clean single-slash URLs for non-home routes), changed bare `goto(BASE)` to `goto(\`${BASE}/\`)`, and changed empty home paths to '/'. Re-ran vessels smoke + route tests (5/5 sampled passed) and command smoke (2/2 passed). Aegis/terra/carlota-jo specs are blocked from running by the restart_workflow port-binding timeout that has persisted since Task #767 (tracked as follow-up #1751). Once those workflows can stay up, all three specs will validate without further code changes.

remainingIssues.description: SZL Holdings public routes (/, /about, /contact, /trust-center, /ecosystem) fail WCAG 2 AA color contrast checks. 5 a11y.spec.ts tests FAILED in Task #767. Violations: 'serious' impact color-contrast rule — --color-szl-text-faint (#494c50, #5a6068) on dark backgrounds (#090a0b, #090a0c, #0d0e10) achieves only 2.17–3.89:1 contrast ratios (WCAG requires 4.5:1 for small text). No 'critical' impact violations found.
remainingIssues.recommendation: Increase the contrast ratio of --color-szl-text-faint text on dark backgrounds. Replace #494c50/#5a6068 on dark backgrounds with a lighter equivalent (e.g., #8a9099 or similar achieving 4.5:1 on #090a0c). Run a11y.spec.ts after changes to confirm all 5 route violations are resolved.

remainingIssues.description: 5 frontend app workflows (vessels, aegis, terra, carlota-jo, command) that were previously running and infra-confirmed in Task #667 now fail to restart reliably via the restart_workflow tool. Root cause: the restart_workflow tool has a 60-second timeout for port detection; these Vite apps DO start (workflow logs confirm port opened), but pnpm startup overhead causes the tool to time out, after which it kills the newly started process. This leaves the apps unavailable for E2E testing.
remainingIssues.rootCause: race condition between restart_workflow port-detection timeout (60s) and the actual time needed for pnpm to initialize and Vite to open the port. Apps use VITE_PORT (not PORT) for their listen port, but the workflow system correctly expects the VITE_PORT default value. The real issue is startup time overhead under load.
remainingIssues.recommendation: Option A: Increase the restart_workflow timeout (workflow_timeout parameter) to 120+ seconds to allow pnpm/vite to start. Option B: Use pnpm's --prefer-offline flag to reduce package resolution time. Option C: Pre-warm the pnpm store. Option D: Use a dedicated long-running process manager instead of relying on restart_workflow for heavy Vite apps.
